senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="M02934">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 59:10">Targ. Is. LIX, 10</cite> (h. text <he>גשש</he>).
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 115:7">Targ. Ps. CXV, 7</cite> (h. text <he>ימיש׳</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:9">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מַשְׁמוּשֵׁי מְמַשְׁמֵשׁ בהו</he> he feels for them (to make sure that he has not lost them).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ממשמש בהו</he> he has been looking after the fruits (which he was carrying, and found out their loss).
<cite ref="Eruvin 41b:19">Erub. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>למשְׁמוּשֵׁי להו זוודתא</he> (not <he>בהו</he>) to make shrouds ready for them.
